workbook_url: https://cdn-eastherts.onwebcurl.com/s3fs-public/2025-11/2025_11 Joint Validation Checklist Herts CC EHDC.pdf
current_evidence: The 'Make a planning application' page links this file as 'Local Validation Requirements for Planning and other applications'. It is the newest of the four validation documents linked (the others are the 2019 national list and the 2021/2023 Local List 2021), and its text reads 'Version 3 (EHDC) 5th December 2024'.

issues.detail: The document date is 5 December 2024 (Version 3), but List date is recorded as 2024-12-01. The day is lost even though the Date basis quotes the exact date.

The joint/shared fields say 'council-specific (no shared list identified)', but the document is a joint validation checklist shared with Hertfordshire County Council. Items are tagged HCC, EHDC or 'HCC & EHDC'.
issues.evidence: Title: 'Joint Validation Checklist for Hertfordshire County Council and Herts District/Borough Councils'

issues.detail: Grokbot also read the superseded 'Local List 2021 - Final' (2021-11) and mixed its text in with the 2024 list. Several tab_items and triggers cite it, e.g. 'USB stick All major applications', scale 1:1250/1:2500 text, and the Noise trigger quoting 'Validation Checklist (October 2021)'. The 2024 checklist renumbered the items (e.g. Scale Bars is now L45).
issues.evidence: tab_items source '.../2021-11/Local List 2021 - Final.pdf'; Noise trigger '...Validation Checklist (October 2021)'

issues.detail: Many East Herts local requirements are not captured. These include: L1(A) Air Quality Neutral Assessment (minor development in or near an AQMA); L2 Affordable Housing Statement; L9 Daylight and Sunlight Assessment (potential adverse impact on neighbours' light); L13 Geo-diverse Assessment; L16 Land Contamination Assessment (possible contamination or sensitive end use); L19 Lighting Statement/Scheme; L21 Noise/Vibration including air source heat pumps near noise-sensitive neighbours; L23 Phasing Plan; L24 Green Belt Statement for Green Belt sites; L27 Retail/Leisure Impact Assessment; L28 Rights of Way; L29 Site Waste Management Plan; L38 Loss of Employment; L39 Loss of Agricultural/Employment Use in Rural Area; L40 Loss of Open Space; L41 Rural Exception Site Needs Assessment; L42 Sequential Test for Main Town Centre Uses; L43 Source Protection Zones; L48 Carbon Reduction Template (new dwellings or non-residential floorspace increase); L50 Community Use Agreement; L52 Equestrian Needs Assessment; L53 Viability Assessment; L56 Harlow and Gilston Garden Town Vision Assurance Statement and L57 HGGT Sustainability Checklist (majors in the HGGT area).
issues.evidence: Joint Validation Checklist EHDC table L1-L57

issues.detail: Householder lists only 'Energy / Sustainability Statement', yet L33 excludes householder applications. The real householder requirements are missing: L5 Biodiversity Questionnaire (all applications except advertisement consent, lawful development certificates and non-material amendments), L45/L46/L49 drawing standards, plus the conditional L11 Ecology (roofspace or attached extensions in the Ecology Consultation Area), L14 Heritage Statement, L36 Tree Survey, L12 Flood Risk Assessment and L47 Vehicle Access Plans.
issues.evidence: L33 Sustainability Statement: 'All applications except householder...'; L5: 'A biodiversity questionnaire is required for all applications except for applications for advertisement consent...'

issues.detail: Advertisement consent lists the Biodiversity Questionnaire, but its own trigger excerpt says advertisement consent is excluded. Lawful development cert lists the Energy/Sustainability Statement, which does not apply to certificates of lawfulness.
issues.evidence: Grokbot's excerpt: 'A biodiversity questionnaire is required for all applications except for applications for advertisement consent'

issues.detail: Design and Access Statement under Listed building consent has the trigger 'All major developments'. A DAS is required for all listed building consent applications, so this is wrong for LBC. The Full planning DAS trigger is a fragment about Agricultural Holdings Certificates.
issues.evidence: N6 Design and Access Statement; Grokbot excerpt '...The Agricultural Holdings Certificate is required to be completed...'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are policy-driver headers or fragments, not the 'When required' text. Examples: Agricultural/rural workers' dwelling and Agricultural Land Classification share the excerpt 'and proposed Agricultural Land Classification is required.'; Air Quality ('Why required - Policy Drivers...'); Heritage Statement ('a means of meeting... paragraph 189'); Structural Survey (text runs into a page header); Travel Plan ('GOV.UK ( L36.'); Statement of Community Involvement ('L32.').

About 40 requirements are placed under Full planning with 'INFERRED: application type not named'. This includes county-only (HCC) items such as minerals/waste statements, which do not apply to district Full planning, and major-only items such as Planning Statement and Travel Plan. Vehicle Access and Site Sections are placed under s73 variations, although N11/L47 do not single out s73.
issues.evidence: Minerals/Waste row trigger: 'disposal and restoration schemes with major tree planting...' (HCC items L4, L7, L20, L26)

issues.detail: Several tab_items are submission instructions or fragments rather than requirements: 'we only require one hard copy...', 'All documents must be provided in a PDF format', 'USB memory stick', 'odour-guidance-2018.pdf (the-ies.org) Details of the baseline...', and repeated 'Do not include the disclaimer do not scale' lines (duplicated four times).

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Joint (HCC/EHDC) Validation Checklist, Version 3 of 5 December 2024. However, the extraction mixes in the superseded 2021 list and misses about two dozen L-coded local requirements. Householder, advertisement and lawful development certificate placements are wrong, contradicting the list's own exclusions.
